title: Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 experimental flying-wing aircraft in flight (Fig. 4)
description: Photograph of the British Armstrong Whitworth A.W. 52 tailless swept-wing aircraft in flight over patchwork farmland, with fins at the wingtips. A pasted label beside it reads "ARMSTRONG WHITWORTH A.W. 52 Experimental Flying-wing Aircraft". Text above gives specifications (span 90 ft, length 37 ft, 2 Nene II turbo jet units). Captioned "Fig. 4".
